reviews.text: I took my older cat Phyllis for dematting and grooming, she had not been to a groomer before and was a little anxious at the start. Lucy was incredibly patient with handling her-  Phyllis was relaxed and happy at the end and it was all a lot easier than I’d been expecting.   She's done an amazing job with the groom, I swear Phyllis has looked a few years younger since the pampering. Highly recommend.

After adopting our 3 year old poodle Ethel I had Lucy at Sunshine Paws recommended by a lady in a local cafe. Lucy explained what would be best for Ethel and answered all my many questions and gave great advice on how to maintain Ethel’s coat. She groomed Ethel beautifully and was brilliant with her. Would highly recommended.
Lucy is a brilliant groomer very professional and is very kind and considerate towards our chow puppy and very patient with him. Lovely lady ! Will never look back

I was quite nervous to take my 2 cats in to be groomed for the first time, but Lucy was so kind and professional she immediately put me at ease.
She clearly loves animals and when I came to pick my cats up they’d had such a good time they didn’t want to leave!
My cats look really smart now, I’ll definitely be booking again soon

We had such a lovely experience with Lucy at Sunshine Paws!

Lucy responded to my enquiry within a few hours and managed to get put frenchie booked in for the following week. She was also really helpful in advising me on which treatment would be best for our pup, as she has been shedding so much lately. The treatment has definitely made a difference and has helped reduce the amount of hair we’re finding around the house!

Our dog can be a little fussy about being brushed and definitely isn’t a fan of hair dryers, so I wasn’t sure how she would get on. Lucy was so calm, patient and gentle with her, and she came home looking really happy and relaxed after her groom. She smelled absolutely gorgeous and was so shiny!

It’s lovely knowing she’s in such patient and caring hands and we will be booking her in for more frequent grooms in the future.

Would definitely recommend Lucy and Sunshine Paws! 🐶🤍
Lucy did a great job with Millie and Millie really enjoyed her groom which is really great because she’s only 6 months old! She’s looking forward to her next groom and blueberry facial!! 😍 …
Lucy is fantastic! She’s done the best job with our Benji, kind and caring and as he’s reactive he felt completely relaxed!! We will be booking in again soon! Thank you so much for a 5* experience!!

I can't praise Lucy enough for the absolutely wonderful job she did grooming my cat, Luna! I was initially a bit nervous about finding the right groomer, as Luna can be quite particular and anxious around new people. However, Lucy's calm and gentle demeanor immediately put both Luna and me at ease.
From the moment we arrived, it was clear that Lucy has a genuine love for animals. She handled Luna with such care and patience, and I could tell Luna felt safe and comfortable in her hands. The groom itself was impeccable.
What truly impressed me was Lucy's ability to connect with Luna. She seemed to understand Luna's personality and adjusted her approach accordingly. The entire experience was stress-free, and Luna came home looking and feeling fantastic.
If you're looking for a groomer who is skilled, compassionate, and truly cares about your pet, look no further than Lucy! I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone seeking top-notch grooming services. Thank you, Lucy, for taking such amazing care of Luna!

My Ragdoll cat Remus was extremely matted due to all the wet weather. I try to groom Remus regularly, though the task became almost impossible and he was clearly uncomfortable, and not grooming himself as he usually does. After being let down and not wanting him to be sedated at the vets, I found lucy. I am so happy I did and so too was Remus. I then booked in for an appointment towards the end of march, though as he was getting more and more matts (which was causing pain and distress)

Lucy fitted us in after hours.
What a breath of fresh air she is, proffessional, friendly, caring and obviously loves her furry customers.

From reading her bio I knew I had found the right groomer for my boy, and she proved that.
Thank you Lucy
Karen and Remus
A wonderful result from hand stripping my 2 beautiful border Terriers. Lucy did a fantastic job and they look amazing. Would definitely recommend! Thank you Lucy!

100% would recommend! Lucy was absolutely amazing and patient with our pup for his first groom. She really took the time to understand his needs and to make the experience as calming as possible for him.😊 …

100% recommend! She was fantastic with our 14 week old cavapoo having his first puppy groom. He’s normally quite anxious around new people and noises, but he was so comfortable around Lucy and we were so impressed with his groom. Was nice to see his eyes again 😂 …

Lucy was very good with my cat Lola who required some matting removing. Lucy went way beyond what I expect and what a super person, this kindness kept Lola calm and content.
We now have a cat without matting and a nice trim ready for Christmas. She's nice and happy now.
Thanks ever so much Lucy.

Lucy was absolutely amazing. It was my cat Spectrums first professional groom and my first time taking any pet to a groomers.

She was patient with both me and Spectrum and he left looking and smelling fabulous!

Can't add a photo but if you go to the Instagram page he's the fluffy white cat wearing a Santa hat haha.

Thank you Lucy! Will be back for his next groom!

I have switched to Lucy at Sunshine Paws recently.  She is very caring and attentive in her work.  Our dog is a little nervous but Lucy only grooms one dog at a time, has classical music playing and does her best to make it a pleasant experience. She has also been helpful if we've needed to change an appointment.  Thank you Lucy.  Willow's mum and dad.  x

My senior rescue cat Lenny had his first ever groom done at Sunshine Paws recently and the whole experience was great. Lucy gave time and attention to ensure he was as relaxed as possible throughout the whole process and Lenny left looking and smelling amazing.

I would highly recommend Lucy for your pet grooming needs!!😊
Great service from start to finish, professional, brilliant advice pre and post groom. Highly recommend

Bert is a rescue dog, and was very frightened of the world, everything was a major hurdle for him but he conquered all.  The last thing on his list after being with me for 2 & 1/2 yrs was to have a groom. I chose Lucy due to excellent reviews, she was so calm and patient with Bert and he thoroughly enjoyed the experience. Thank you Lucy , we’ll be back

We took our four month old puppy to Sunshine and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Our pup is a little shy of other people so we spoke to Lucy ahead of time to organise a visit prior to her appointment to get familiar with the space. Lucy went above and beyond to make Bernie feel comfortable and confident. She did a fantastic job of her puppy cut and showed us footage of Bernie during her appointment so we could see how she did. She’s given us fair recommendations of how often to book in for optimum coat care and the booking system works a treat! All in, Lucy offers a fantastic service and is lovely to work with, I couldn’t recommend her more!

Lucy did an excellent job helping my cat Bear who had multiple knots on his stomach that needed removing. Not an easy job and it was Bears first time at a groomers, Lucy was very calm and patient with him and managed to get all his knots without Bear getting stressed. Would definitely recommend and will be back when he's ready for his next groom ☺️

Lucy did an amazing job last weekend on Wesley, he has been getting compliments since visiting. He feels softer and being a British shorthair so much less hair is coming away and his coat feels healthy and soft.  First time I had taken him to the groomers and Lucy dealt with our 1st visit very professionally, friendly and helpful - I felt very comfortable to leave Wesley in her care and I will definitely be back in a few months for a fresh trim and clean :) Thank you again

Lucy is so lovely and gave my 14 week old puppy a wonderful first experience of grooming. He is a bit of a scaredy cat so I was worried he might be frightened, but he was bouncing around when I picked him up and had clearly had a ball. Would definitely recommend any new puppy parents to Sunshine Paws!
Highly recommend Lucy at Sunshine Paws. An amazing experience for my cat and her first time being groomed. Lucy was patient, kind and so knowledgeable. Perfect little shop too in a great spot!
Very friendly. My cat was handled gently and carefully. He was groomed as requested and his fur is now much more manageable.
Took our golden retriever for a trim and we were very impressed with how he looked! This will now be our regular groomers.

My Cavapoos Poppy and Pippin love going to Lucy at Sunshine Paws. They get very excited when we go to her shop.
Poppy and Pippin always look and smell lovely after their appointment.

Reggie, our German Wirehaired Pointer, always looks so handsome after visiting Lucy, she does a fantastic job every time!
Even as a big, wriggly dog, he always looks perfect after his grooms!
Definitely recommend Lucy 💕 …

Our puppy had a great first grooming experience at Sunshine Paws, Lucy was very nice, calm and welcoming and the parlour was a very relaxing environment so Ozzy was at ease straight away. He came home looking a very smart boy indeed! Thanks Lucy!

absolutely recommend lucy! she took such great care of my puppy willow and made her feel so comfortable and loved. it’s always a little nerve-wracking leaving your pup with someone ( but lucy was amazing from the start. willow came back happy, relaxed, and clearly well looked after. you can tell lucy really loves what she does and treats every dog like her own. so glad we found her – we’ll definitely be back☺️

Lucy is absolutely amazing! She's very knowledgeable about grooming and was so comforting to my feral cat, who has not been keen on anyone touching him. She took her time to make sure he was at ease, taking short breaks when she felt he could use them.  I was a groomer for over 20 years and I was highly impressed with her.  I'm so grateful to have her as my cat's groomer.

Also, her price for the groom was a more than fair price. To be fair, I would have happily paid more because her work was that good!
Lucy has been amazing from making the enquiry to taking Marli for her first professional wash and blow. Will use again and highly recommend using her

Lucy did an amazing job grooming and giving my BooBoo a lion cut. She’s a very caring  groomer who skilfully navigated her clippers around BooBoo’s delicate areas. Lucy was mindful of BooBoo’s mental state and reacted intuitively to his mood. He was offered treats and didn’t seem stressed by the experience. Thank you Lucy! We will definitely be back for his next lion cut next year 😉
Came in with our Maine Coon for his first cut.   Lucy was so gentle and patient which really put him at ease. Overall great experience and we have already booked in for his next trim!

Brilliant Job by Lucy.  A much needed first proper cut for Lottie the mini schnauzer.

Great job
Absolutely amazing

What a lovely groomer Lucy is. She really took care of my Persian cat Annie. She made time to make sure that Annie felt safe and even gave her little treats along the way to help her settle. Her lovely shorter and neater coat looks so smart. I will definitely be back. Thank you from Annie and her please cat owner.
Great job grooming my cat! Thanks Lucy :)
We’ve been to Lucy’s twice now and she’s done a great job on both occasions! Definitely recommend.
Very happy with the service and my Maltipoo looks lovely. It meant a lot to me that Lucy took a little time to get to know my puppy. Thank you would recommend sunshine paws.

Marley had his first puppy groom today with Lucy in guisley. Marley looks lovely and he seemed to enjoy his first groom. Lucy explained everything that she was going to do with him. Marley come out wagging his tail and very happy. We will definitely be booking back in for future grooms. Thank you.

Excellent! We have two border terriers - one is a sweet angel boy and the other is quite spicy... They both now look so smart and handsome after a strip. Lucy has done such a great job with them - working with them to make sure they were comfortable during the groom. We were concerned about our spicy dog as he has big feelings but also had a bad leg, but she's done a wonderful job with him. We will definitely book them in again here!

I took my Labrador Molly to Lucy for the first time today and was very happy. Lucy was great with Molly and did a brilliant job with the groom. She was very happy when I picked her up and smelt lovely. We’ll definitely be back 😊 …
My dog Hope enjoyed her grooming and teeth clean , fantastic job and calming environment. Thank you Lucy oh and she smelt lovely when I picked her up . Definitely recommend 🤩 …

I currently had a bad experience with a previous groomer which  took me a while to get the courage to trust anybody else with my princess  saw sunshine paws dog and cat grooming had opened an something just said to me go for it an so glad I did ruby  has had the most amazing experience today finally  my trust has been restored she  did everything I asked ( cutting style etc )  ruby  had the best time full of chihuahua smiles  sticking out tounge when I went to pick her up she can't wait to go back
Please anyone who has had a negative experience
Come here rest assured Ur dogs dream will come true an be as pampered as a royal dog  thank u so much see u in 2 month love Becky an ruby

Herbert was treat like a prince . He is a very anxious little pooch as he lost his owner a month ago so just adjusting to me.  Lucy was so lovely and made him feel at ease . His groom was first class . Thank you it was a great job can not fault the service Lucy is very in tune with the well-being of the dogs xxx

Lucy has done an incredible job of grooming our Toy Poodle, she looks amazing. I love how she has cut her, she listened to what i wanted and has done exactly that! She was able to get to her ears which another reputable groomer couldn’t and i know dolly was happy and didnt seem anxious when i collected her. Lucy is a lovely girl with clearly lots of experience, she is softly spoken and and gives great advice, i have absolutely rebooked for 6 weeks! Thank you so much Lucy xx

Lucy did a fantastic job with Bailey's teeth! I had tried at home but didn't have enough arms to wrangle her and brush her teeth, but Lucy managed it with ease and got so much plaque off. I'm so pleased with the results, we've already booked her next visit!
Fantastic with my schnauzers, highly recommend 👌 …
Couldn't be happier with the service Lucy provided! Well organised, great communication, wonderful with Bella and amazing service, and very reasonably priced!

I would 100% recommend Lucy! My golden retriever Lottie had her first groom, she looked and smelt fabulous afterwards! Lucy informed me of what the process would look like and reassured me of steps she would take if Lottie struggled with any aspect of the process!
I look forward to bringing her next time ☺️

For a long time we’d been looking for a cat groomer to clear and groom the matted coat of our very long-haired Siberian cat.  Lucy at Sunshine Paws rose to the challenge and made an excellent job of ‘de-matting’ him. She is patient, careful and skilful - and needed to be to tackle a big, strong cat with a mind of his own.  She did it - and were are pleased with the result.  We’ll be back for regular grooming sessions.
Did a brilliant job with my Simba

Our experience at Sunshine Paws was excellent.
It’s the first time our cat has been professionally groomed, Lucy was so good with her,  very patient, friendly and professional. Our cat stayed calm throughout the hour, it was very relaxing,  Lucy  also gave us tips and advice. I would definitely recommend Lucy and we will certainly go back!
My partner took our two (rather long haired!) cats for a groom - and we're both so pleased with the result!  Merry and Pippin look so much more comfortable.  We'll be back again!

Couldn't be happier with the service at Sunshine Paws. My cockapoo had his first professional groom in 3 years with Lucy and he looked (and smelled) incredible after his session! The online booking was also really easy to use. I would absolutely recommend Sunshine Paws to anyone looking for a friendly, fuss-free and professional dog grooming experience.
Used Lucy for the first time recently. Our dog looks fantastic, Lucy did exactly what we asked for and we will be using her again. Thank you.

I took my two young cats for their first groom with Lucy today and it was a fantastic experience! Lucy really cared about doing a great job whilst also not stressing them out and she got that balance perfectly. Really felt like their wellbeing was considered at all times. Pippin was ever purring by the end of the appointment! Will absolutely be back ☺️
Lucy is really passionate about dog grooming she really listens to what you want . Bob comes back happy and beautiful groomed

Leon had a fabulous time being groomed, he's a bit nervous but he came back very pleased with himself and he looked amazing! The bandana and card are such a nice touch. We will definitely be back, thank you so much x
Lucy was very easy to communicate with and she was very gentle/ encouraging to Sheba's first ever groom. I can't recommend enough and thank you for your excellent service 😀 …
Took my dog to Lucy for his first groom. Really pleased with the results, she did an amazing job and he had such a good time.
Thank you for you review Val 🙂 Looking forward to seeing you and Barney again soon 🐾 …
Thank you for your review Emily. It really means a lot! ❤️

I took my basset hound Winnie to Lucy today, Winnie is only 9 month old and this was her first groom. Despite Winnie being a bit difficult for Lucy she still did great job, we are very happy and have already booked our second groom with Lucy. Thank you!
Excellent grooming, very happy with the result . Lucy is a star !

Lucy is brilliant with Bonnie my cockapoo (despite her being a bossy dog about her paws being done!)  She is so kind and patient with her. I'd never take Bonnie to any other groomers. So glad we found Lucy!
Would 100% recommend Sunshine Paws, had such a lovely first experience here and my puppy loved it. Lucy is lovely and was really attentive to my puppy’s needs

I recently had my two cats, Muezza and Zuri, groomed by Lucy, and I couldn't be more pleased with the experience! I was initially worried that my cats might exhibit anxiety and stress upon their return, but that was not the case at all.

Lucy did a wonderful job with both of them. Muezza and Zuri came back looking absolutely fabulous and more relaxed than ever. The groomer’s gentle and caring approach made a significant difference, and it was clear that she took the time to ensure my cats were comfortable throughout the process.

The professionalism and expertise of Lucy truly shine through in the quality of their work. I highly recommend Sunshine Paws services to anyone looking for a top-notch cat grooming experience. Thank you for taking such great care of Muezza and Zuri!
Absolute lovely service my dog received from this place. He went in smelling of fox poo and came out smelling of roses, and he loved it too. Will defo be going back

We’ve been taking our puppy Pickle to Lucy since she was young and she now loves the groomers thanks to the amazing experience Lucy has given her! We love the extras as well like tennis balls when it’s Wimbledon ! We are very happy clients who will continue to use Lucy’s expertise !
Thank you for your review 😊 …
Excellent groomer. Arthur had his first groom with them today and what a fantastic job they have done. I could not be happier! Thank you so much for looking after my bubba xx highly recommend !!

Hamish went to Lucy for the first time last week, infact his first time ever at a grooming parlour. Lucy did a brilliant job and Hamish looked great when I collected him . Cannot thank her enough and he's already booked in for his next visit to Sunshine Paws Dog Grooming.

Thank you for fitting Zuma in at short notice .
Lucy did a great job on a rather crazy sprocker spaniel we had staying with us .
He came home looking and smelling lovely.

Took my 6 month old cane corso to see Lucy yesterday, it was his first groom and I couldn’t of asked for a better person to take him to! He smells amazing and more than anything sunshine paws felt like home!!great place, great staff!! The only place I’d go!

Lucy did amazing with our lab, Howard! He is a boisterous, playful dog and he’d never been groomed before so we weren’t sure how he’d be, but she looked after him really well and he had an amazing time. He looked fantastic when we picked him up! Super trim, and even managed his paws and nails which he’s normally very picky about. He came out wearing a cute little scarf and Lucy did us a painted paw print card as it was his first time.  Lovely experience. Will definitely be rebooking for his next groom in a couple months! XOX
Thank you for your review 😊 …

Lucy has been amazing! Had our first groom today and he looks and smells amazing! Really reasonably priced and Lucy was great with our dog Kai. Will definitely be booking here again in the near future. Really happy with the service we have received and we have one very smiley dog!

Nala had her first puppy groom with Lucy at Sunshine Paws today and we couldn’t recommend her highly enough! Lucy talked us through the whole process beforehand and took the time to get our puppy used to everything to make sure it was a positive experience. Nala can’t wait for her next visit! Thanks again.

I took my dog for her first ever groom and was very happy with the result. I was really pleased with what Lucy was able to do for my dog as she needed a lot of work. I would definitely recommend,  we will be back soon.  Thank you once again.
